data.title: Numbers — Beginner · Lesson 2
data.subject: numbers
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey, hey, we're on the road again...

[Hook]
Numbers in the air… Números en el aire
Let's count from there… Vamos a contar desde allí
Six, seven, eight… Seis, siete, ocho
Nine, ten, let's celebrate… Nueve, diez, vamos a celebrar
Vamos, amigos, let's go… Vamos, amigos, vamos.

[Verse]
Sun's up high, we're feeling free,
Uno, dos, tres, just you and me.
Four wheels spinning, cinco stars in sight,
Four… Cuatro, five… Cinco, under the moonlight.
Windows down, the music's loud,
Seis amigos, feeling proud.
Seven… Siete, miles to go,
Eight… Ocho, more to know.

[Hook]
Numbers in the air… Números en el aire
Let's count from there… Vamos a contar desde allí
Six, seven, ocho… Seis, siete, ocho
Nine, diez, let's celebrate… Nueve, diez, vamos a celebrar
Vamos, amigos, let's go… Vamos, amigos, vamos.

[Verse]
Nine… Nueve, clouds in the sky,
Ten… Diez, dreams passing by.
We're singing loud, feeling alive,
Tres, cuatro, cinco, let's come alive.
Seven… Siete, mountains in our way,
